object.body:
Hello $data.requesterName,

Your request to $data.operationType.toLowerCase() account $data.accountName on $data.sourceName was completed successfully.

The account has been removed from the source.


Thanks,
The $__global.productName Team
object.description: Sent to a requester to confirm that their account delete request has been completed successfully.
object.name: Account Deletion Request Completed
object.subject: $data.sourceName – $data.operationType request successfully completed for $data.accountName
